# Inline Part

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InlinePart`](gmeow-InlinePart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InlinePart>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A body part displayed inline within the message body, such as an embedded image or a text/html part rendered as part of the message content. Distinct from [`Attachment`](gmeow-Attachment.md) in presentation intent but not declared disjoint — a part's disposition is an attributed fact, not a rigid kind boundary ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InlinePart`](gmeow-InlinePart.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
